recipes.name: Chipotle chicken burrito bowls
steps: Start 1 cup dry rice in the rice cooker.
Cube the chicken, toss with oil, chili powder and a pinch of salt.
Cook in a hot pan 7-8 min until no pink remains (165 F inside).
Warm the beans in the microwave 2 min.
Split rice, beans and chicken into 2 containers; top with salsa, yogurt and lime.

remix.2026-10-27 lunch: Roll it into a tortilla with hot sauce for a burrito you can eat walking to class.

recipes.storage: Fridge, up to 3 days. Keep the yogurt separate until you eat.

recipes.name: Korean-style turkey rice bowls
steps: Brown the turkey with garlic 6-7 min, breaking it up.
Stir in soy sauce and gochujang; cook 1 min.
Wilt the spinach in the same pan, 1 min.
Serve over rice with an egg on top; pack the second bowl without the egg and fry a fresh one Wednesday.

remix.2026-10-28 dinner: Fry a fresh egg and add kimchi or cucumber for crunch; post-workout, add an extra 1/2 cup rice.
